spellbook.finance/limitations: workspaceId validates caller ownership only. Combined-shipping rules belong to the connected eBay account and can affect eligible listings across all of the caller's workspaces.
The Account API combined-shipping rule has no item-count setting; eBay checkout may still require multiple items. Verify the single-item buyer cart.

An amount-only minimum-purchase Shipping discount must be configured in eBay Seller Hub; the Marketing API does not support Shipping discounts, so SpellBook Finance MCP cannot read or write that offer.
A Seller Hub campaign saved as a draft while Discounts Manager Terms acceptance is pending is not active; verify acceptance and publication in Seller Hub.
A provider rule readback does not prove a listing is associated or a buyer receives the discount at checkout.
Use missingFields and limitations for association and checkout evidence.

description: Read the caller's connected eBay combined-shipping profile and promotional shipping rule, including its provider type, amount threshold or maximum order cost, and configuration status. Call spellbook_ebay_combined_shipping_set after reviewing it. eBay checkout may still require multiple items for an amount-threshold offer; use eBay Seller Hub Shipping discounts when a minimum amount must qualify one item.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.
